_comment: Hand-entered fields the NHL API can't provide. Keyed by game date (YYYY-MM-DD). Fields: mdo, morningSkate, dayBeforeSkate, earlyArrival, specialTeamsWin, specialTeamsTie, contestedFoWin, elevenF7D, notes. This file merges into the page live in the browser — edit it via docs/editor.html, or by hand here. No pipeline run needed for changes here to show up.
